theorems.proof_goal: Show that O composition is associative only within a restricted domain where intermediate admissibility, Ref(.) equivalence, residue context, and legal recoupling conditions are preserved.
assumptions: all L compositions remain admissible or legally recoupled
all Q transitions preserve Ref(.) equivalence or cite R_RECOUPLING_V1
residue context remains consistent across groupings
d_Omega divergence remains bounded where reference comparison is required

proof_obligations.statement: Show that L-component associativity holds for admissible-preserving chains.
Show that Q-component grouping equivalence holds when Ref(.) equivalence class is preserved.
Show that equivalence-changing groupings remain conditionally associative only when R_RECOUPLING_V1 supplies the same legal recoupling context to both groupings.
Show that degeneracy boundaries preserve grouping equivalence only when set-valued -(i) is retained.
Classify all blocked-L, forbidden-Q, memoryless-recouping, and inconsistent-residue cases as non-associative or invalid.

requires: all OASSOC proof obligations discharged conditionally or fully
